about: C4.5 (P-130, P-319; Lead 9's ruling, 5 Nov): the facts each document type of the six supplies, which an author proposes in the library and a second person approves (POST /api/library/document-types/:key/supplies, then To review). The packs make that person's step with this file; the product never reads it. Each fact cites the official words that say the document shows it (AGENTS.md rule 4, P-170): form, edition, page and quote, read on 5 Nov 2026 from the committed files official-sources/ircc/checklists/imm5484e.pdf (SHA-256 e48deef4a6343edda19e04b3ab598a275b12bb07047d4351f00c7c239f7883fc) and official-sources/ircc/forms/imm5257e.pdf (SHA-256 0dc03b24e7914a178ad29e2cfae811045835a1d36d7a3c35f040251d0aca562e), whose words are in prototype/expected/source-text/. A fact no official words tie to the document is left out (the passport's country of issue: IMM 5257 asks it in its Passport section but does not say the passport shows it). Sample, Unconfirmed: expert.

document_types.reason: IMM 5484 lists what the passport's information page includes, and IMM 5257 asks the names as shown on the passport (Sample, Unconfirmed: expert).
